provenance.bore: Published WD615 specification (126 mm); multiple supplier spec sheets.
provenance.cylinder_count: Published: in-line 6, four-stroke, water-cooled direct-injection diesel.
provenance.displacement: Derived: pi/4 x 126^2 x 130 x 6 = 9.726 L, matches the published 9.726 L.
provenance.rated_power_kw: Published WD615.69 rating 247 kW (336 hp) at 2200 rpm; declared input only.
provenance.target_compression_ratio: Published value about 17:1; the bowl depth is solved to meet it.
provenance.rod_length: Secondary source (Chinese structural article: 219 mm centre distance); not confirmed in an OEM manual.
provenance.cylinder_spacing: ASSUMPTION (150 mm); not found in available sources.
provenance.compression_height: ASSUMPTION (80 mm), chosen so the modelled piston mass matches the catalog piston (2.185 kg).
provenance.valve_timing: ASSUMPTION: typical heavy-diesel timing IVO 20 BTDC / IVC 46 ABDC / EVO 50 BBDC / EVC 20 ATDC.
provenance.journal_and_pin_diameters: ASSUMPTION: main journal 100 mm, crank pin 82 mm.
provenance.valvetrain: Two valves per cylinder with pushrods from a block-mounted camshaft (WD615 architecture); sizes are assumptions.
provenance.port_layout: ASSUMPTION: counter-flow ports (intake and exhaust on the same side); not verified against the OEM head.
provenance.gear_train: ASSUMPTION: rear gear train crank 36T / idler 24T / cam 72T / pump 72T, module 4.
